info.about: Pocky & Rocky with Becky is a shoot 'em up video game for the Game Boy Advance handheld game console where the player may control either Pocky, Rocky, or Becky, the latter originating from the spin-off KiKi KaiKai: Dotou-hen, as they attempt to defeat a ghostly hydra who escaped his seal. The player character takes two hits to lose a life, but only one in Japan.
